newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Malaysian firm to buy 6.78 pct in Sierad.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian firm to buy 6.78 pct in Sierad.

text.p: Malaysia's integrated poultry and fast food chain Kentucky Fried Chicken Holding BHD has agreed to buy 50 million shares of Indonesia's PT Sierad Produce, Sierad said in a statement on Friday.
This represents a 6.78 percent stake in the Indonesian firm.
Sierad said KFC's investment represented "a first step in forging a strategic alliance".
Based on the Jakarta stock exchange record on February 13, PT Sierad had 737.84 million shares listed.
The statement did not provide details of the total price of the deal. Sierad officials were not immediately available for comment.
In late afternoon trading on the Jakarta exchange, Sierad fell 25 rupiah to 850 rupiah on a volume of 1.3 million shares.
Sierad said the two companies had many similarities in their core businesses and the alliance would increase the possibilities for future developments in both Indonesia and Malaysia.
KFC Holding is known for its operation in integrated poultry and fast food chains, such as Kentucky Fried Chicken and Pizza Hut in Malaysia and Brunei, the statement said.
